title: Limit the retained Surface gradient to its renderer draw

scope.subject: Keep the exact authored software horizon and single Canvas, but stop a Surface texture restoration leaking into the next System frame.

research_summary: Both frozen R5 LOW repeated tests reached first outward logical System 1.000 with the same retained native star active, but physical System frame awaited after 13s; only one additional WebGL metrics sample and a new program/geometry. Unchanged original route exact frozen R4/R5 Chromium profiles both pass ordinarily, and both concretely compile the software Surface-only Three BackgroundMaterial on their first outward System frame (311/345ms frame, 302/339ms shader diagnostics). This is independent of R5 first notch. R3F independently attaches background at several transitioning React subtrees, restoring previous owner values on detach; Surface already gates terrain visibility synchronously through phaseRef, but the background attachment is separate. Keep hardware CSS/colors and unchanged authored Surface DataTexture. Bind its participation to the exact existing Surface pre/post render lifetime, preserve actual handoff and cameras; prove real texture/GL draw not present outside Surface. Do not attribute all hosted raster pressure to this one shader without a matching sequence.

sources.finding: Two frozen failures on first return, queued intent and same native owner remain valid; no physical frame/one metrics sample over test budget and cold program within that frame.
Existing Surface group is given synchronous phase ownership before actual paint; keep same Lifecycle and add SW background to the same scope only.
Existing server React parent is one Canvas: priorities before and after the current render bracket a temporary native Three resource without rendering again.
An actual Texture background allocates a plane geometry and the named internal BackgroundMaterial; a Color does not.

search_ladder.conclusion: Keep native and fallback rendering unchanged and one shared Canvas; no new timeline or handoff state.
Keep the exact Three background texture and existing R3F pre-/post-render callbacks that already establish renderer draw ownership.
Only install temporary Software Surface background in actual Surface frames and restore the earlier scene value, without a sticky attach stack.
Retain one existing DataTexture, explicit limits, and an inline guarded lease scoped to the existing draw and teardown.

candidates.name: Bracket authored background inside the existing Surface draw
candidates.source: Pinned React Three Fiber frame priorities and same native Three scene/background
candidates.reason: No rendering, math, texture or quality reduction; prevents unnecessary off-owner draw/program and leaves the existing camera handoff as sole authority.

candidates.name: Remove the SW horizon or use the original flat fallback color
candidates.source: Existing Three Color path in SurfaceScene
candidates.reason: Visual regression; output must be unchanged during own Surface paint.

candidates.name: Add dedicated Surface background layer or pass, or wholesale global background refactor
candidates.reason: Exceeds bounded fix, adds draw and duplicate output risks. Existing two callbacks and same native draw are sufficient.

decision.rationale: Apply runtime-identifiable Surface-only texture exclusively to existing Surface draw; the existing independent scene colours no longer inherit it.
decision.fallback: Preserve approved matched code and report accurately if paired browser tests do not show both significant measured off-owner reduction and exact Surface preservation.
